name: Saltwall Testimony: A Shelf Crime Drama
description: A long-running serialized crime drama in which viewers inhabit rotating perspectives across a single Tier 1 precinct block — the investigating officer, the suspect, the witness, the fixer — over the course of one case per season. Written and performed by a rotating ensemble anchored by lead showrunner Chiamaka Osei-Vreeland, the series refuses resolution: most seasons end with the guilty party walking and the witness relocated or disappeared. Neural-feed immersion means viewers have literally experienced wrongful arrest, coerced testimony, and evidence suppression from the inside.
cultural_impact: Introduced the phrase 'Saltwall justice' into common Tier 1-3 slang, meaning any outcome that was technically legal and entirely wrong.
story_hooks: A player character is contacted by someone who claims to be the real perpetrator from Season 3 — the one the show said walked — and they want to finish what the series started.
The original Season 6 uncut feed has surfaced on a dead drop; someone inside Vantablack wants it authenticated and released before the network finds out.
The showrunner has gone silent mid-production on Season 9; her last message to the writers' room said only 'they know which block we're based on.'
